saints.name: The Holy Guardian Angels
saints.title: Angelic Guardians
saints.shortBlurb: The heavenly guardians whom God appoints to watch over, protect, and pray for each human soul…
biography: The Church has always taught, on the witness of Scripture, that God assigns to each of the faithful an angel to guard body and soul. Our Lord himself speaks of the little ones whose angels “always behold the face of my Father who is in heaven,” and the Psalms declare that God has given his angels charge to keep us in all our ways.

A feast of the Guardian Angels was celebrated in various places from the sixteenth century and was extended to the universal Church by Pope Clement X in 1670. It is kept on the day after the feast of the Archangels, giving thanks for the unseen protection that accompanies every Christian through life.
saints.knownFor: God's appointment of an angel to guard each soul.
